definitions.name: Z3C.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'DK' BIND 1 DK RANGE [ DK DIV RATIO 0 GET 1 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: Ascending positive divisors of a positive integer (d divides k iff d/k has numerator 1).

definitions.name: Z3C.ISPRIME
definitions.note: TRUE when a positive integer has exactly two divisors.

definitions.name: Z3C.UPSTEP
definitions.body: 'EL' BIND 'AC' BIND AC 0 GET 1 ADD 'XX' BIND XX 0 EL SELECT 'CU' BIND CU CU AC 1 GET MAX 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step on [run best] with a truth element: extend the run or reset it, keep the best.

definitions.name: Z3C.COLSTEP
definitions.body: 'EL' BIND 'AC' BIND AC 0 GET 'CX' BIND AC 1 GET 'CS' BIND CX 1 EQ 'DN' BIND CX 2 DIV FLOOR 'HF' BIND HF 2 MUL CX EQ 'EV' BIND HF CX 3 MUL 1 ADD EV SELECT 'NV' BIND CX NV DN SELECT 'NX' BIND CS CS 1 ADD DN SELECT 'NS' BIND NX NS 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step on [x steps] applying one Collatz move unless x is already 1.

definitions.name: Z3C.FIBSTEP
definitions.body: 'EL' BIND 'AC' BIND AC 0 GET 'FA' BIND AC 1 GET 'FB' BIND AC 2 GET 'FC' BIND AC 3 GET 'NV' BIND FA NV LT 'LTN' BIND FC 1 ADD FC LTN SELECT 'NC' BIND FB FA FB ADD NC NV 4 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step on [F(j) F(j+1) count n]: counts the Fibonacci terms below n.

definitions.name: Z3C.DELTA
definitions.body: 'CH' BIND 1 -1 CH '(' EQ NOT CH '[' EQ NOT AND NOT SELECT

definitions.name: Z3C.REDSTEP
definitions.note: One reduction round: delete every adjacent () and [] pair (element ignored).

definitions.name: Z3C.RED
definitions.note: Bracket String reduced to its irreducible remainder (8 rounds cover 12 characters).

definitions.name: Z3C.SCORE
definitions.body: 'PP' BIND PP CHARS LENGTH 0 PP Z3C.RED CHARS LENGTH 0 EQ SELECT
definitions.note: Length of a bracket prefix if it is balanced, else 0.

definitions.name: Z3C.FILLSTEP
definitions.body: 'EL' BIND 'AC' BIND EL AC EL NIL? NOT SELECT
definitions.note: SCAN step: a present reading replaces the carried value, a missing one keeps it.

definitions.name: Z3C.GAPSTEP
definitions.body: 'EL' BIND 'AC' BIND AC 0 GET 'CN' BIND AC 1 GET 'PV' BIND EL NIL? 'MI' BIND CN 1 ADD CN MI PV NOT AND SELECT 'NC' BIND NC MI 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step on [gap count, previous missing]: counts starts of missing runs.

definitions.name: Z3C.GAPMAX
definitions.body: 'EL' BIND 'AC' BIND AC 0 GET 'CU' BIND AC 1 GET 'BE' BIND EL NIL? 'MI' BIND CU 1 ADD 0 MI SELECT 'NC' BIND NC NC BE MAX 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step on [current missing run, longest run].

definitions.name: Z3C.LINE
definitions.body: 'OD' BIND OD 'qty' GET OD 'price' GET 0 OD 'price' GET NIL? NOT SELECT MUL
definitions.note: qty times price for an order record, 0 when the order has no price.

definitions.name: Z3C.REVENUE
definitions.note: Total of qty times price over an orders Vector.

definitions.name: Z3C.TAGS
definitions.body: 'OD' BIND OD 'tags' GET 'TG' BIND TG [ ] TG NIL? NOT SELECT UNIQUE
definitions.note: Distinct tags of one order record; an empty Vector when it has none.

definitions.name: Z3C.CAP
definitions.body: 'WD' BIND WD CHARS 0 GET UPPER WD CHARS 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: Word with its first letter upper case and the rest lower case.
